description.subtitle: Pair of Nike Half Cane Soccer Training Socks - Black
description.tagline: Power and control in each training
description.intro: With Nike Strike Crew black socks you will feel safe at every pace change. Designed to provide stability, comfort and shock absorption at the most intense moments of the game.
key_benefits: Control sensation: The anatomical structure adapts to each foot.
Additional protection: Shock absorber in critical areas to reduce impacts.
Sober design: Total black, combinable with any equipment.
Constant performance: Thought for maximum level training.
